text:
maria (procurement): Hyperline proposing split wave 65% sea / 35% air. FRA dock congestion risk flagged. Need RMA label format confirmation.

kevin (logistics): Recommend hedging: 32 units air-priority, rest sea. Air cost +13% but reduces deploy risk.

alex (vendor:hyperline): We can split AWBs. Air ETA 6-8d, sea 16-20d. We will provide CSV manifest; default labels are vendor-generic unless you send format. Insurance optional.

siva (ops): We need manifest before sail to match depot parser. Required header: serial,model,mfg_date,vendor_sku. Wrong labels => manual triage +24-48h.

maria (procurement): Can vendor add standby uplift clause (air uplift if port blocked) and SLA to notify delays >48h?

alex (vendor:hyperline): Can add standby uplift at +11% on uplifted units and 12h notify SLA for customs holds. Will upload sample label + CSV template.

kevin (logistics): Please include `status` column if replacements are mixed (NEW, DOA, REFURB). Also provide sha256 checksum for manifest.

siva (ops): Confirm HS code 8471.80 on docs. If customs reclassification occurs, we require doubled declared-insurance.

maria (procurement): Approve up to +12% uplift if it materially reduces deploy risk. Alex, upload files to shared drive by EOD and ping.

alex (vendor:hyperline): Uploaded sample label and CSV template: https://drive.redwood/inbound/hyper-1795. AWB placeholders: AIR-HYP1795, SEA-HYP1795. Booking queued BK-1795.

logistics-bot: Booking BK-1795 created. Watchers: kevin, siva.

kevin (logistics): I'll review proforma for re-route wording. Standby uplift ok under +12% ceiling.

siva (ops): Once manifest uploaded we'll run `sha256sum manifest.csv` and validate.

maria (procurement): Thanks, marking active. Legal will review any changes to T&Cs for re-route clause.
